Senior Frontend Engineer — Razorpay (Bengaluru, Hybrid)

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Checkout team. You will build fast, accessible payment experiences used by millions of customers every day.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain high-quality web applications using React, TypeScript and Next.js
- Own the performance of our checkout: Core Web Vitals, bundle size, lazy loading
- Collaborate with designers and product managers to ship new features end to end
- Write unit and integration tests with Jest and React Testing Library; maintain Cypress or Playwright end-to-end suites
- Contribute to our design system built with Storybook and Tailwind CSS
- Mentor junior engineers and review pull requests

Requirements
- 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
- Deep experience with React and state management (Redux, Zustand or similar)
- Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git and code review
- Solid understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design

Nice to have
- Experience with micro-frontends, Webpack or Vite
- Knowledge of Node.js
- Experience in fintech or payments

We offer competitive salary, ESOPs, health insurance and flexible working hours. Razorpay is an equal opportunity employer.
